content.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas Apr. 18-19, 2026 | Tickets and News
content.text: April 18 and 19, 2026 at Allegiant Stadium After a record-breaking, history-making event last year, WWE’s flagship spectacle returns to Vegas. April 18 & 19, 2026, at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, NV. How can I buy WrestleMania 42 tickets? What other WWE events are happening? In addition to two nights of WrestleMania, WWE will bring Monday Night Raw, Friday Night SmackDown, Stand & Deliver and WWE World – a multi-day interactive fan experience What do official WrestleMania 42 Priority Passes include? Official WrestleMania 42 Priority Passes offers fans premium seating, hospitality events with Superstar appearances, exclusive photo opportunities, and more. Fans can place a deposit to secure access ahead of the general public. To learn more about WrestleMania 42 Priority Passes or to place a deposit, please visit: https://onlocationexp.com/wm42 Is there a minimum age for WrestleMania packages? No minimum age is required to purchase WrestleMania tickets or attend the event. However, a valid ID is necessary for collecting your Priority Pass credentials. How do I get to Allegiant Stadium? Many Las Vegas hotels are within walking distance to Allegiant Stadium.
